stories.headline: OpenAI raises $11 billion, sources say
stories.summary: Reuters sources say OpenAI closed $11 billion in initial funding at a $1.25 trillion valuation, below the $1.5 trillion initially sought. The report is source-based, not an independently reviewed company filing.

stories.headline: US adds 165,000 jobs; unemployment at 4.1%
stories.summary: BLS reports October payroll employment rose 165,000 and unemployment was 4.1%. These are survey estimates subject to revision, not a forecast of the Fed's next decision.

stories.headline: Trump names Stephen Miller chief of staff
stories.summary: Trump named Stephen Miller to replace Susie Wiles as chief of staff effective Monday, November 9. The personnel change is confirmed; predictions of a more confrontational policy approach remain analysis.

stories.headline: Qatar says US–Iran mediation continues
stories.summary: Qatar's prime minister says mediation continues and progress has been made. Iranian media separately report possible missile strikes on Qeshm; damage and attribution remain unconfirmed in this report. No agreement is announced.

stories.headline: Russian strikes damage Kyiv power infrastructure
stories.summary: Ukrainian officials report serious damage to energy infrastructure and Kyiv's Northern Bridge after overnight attacks. Casualty and interception figures remain official accounts. Planned peace talks have not halted the fighting.
